description:
An insightful session with PP Rtn. Vinay Vyas, Corporate Lawyer with 36 years of experience and District Chair – Rotary Leadership Institute (RLI).
🎙️ Topic: “Passing on Wealth, Not Disputes: The Importance of Making a Will”
A highly relevant session for every family—understanding how timely estate planning can protect your loved ones and help avoid future disputes.
